architecture_invariants: User Principal is the caller/accountability root, not an Agent.
Device is the execution substrate and key custodian, not the public callee.
Display/window/application Resource URA is the Invocation subject.
WebRTC/native media is a session transport, not a second Invocation model.

requirements.requirement: Application/window selection and stable capture across macOS/Windows/Linux
current_evidence: macOS ScreenCaptureKit application filter excludes uncommitted same-app same-display windows from committed window-set sessions
non-macOS app/window target observation fails closed
required_evidence_before_product_complet: real macOS host E2E for display/window/application capture
real Windows host E2E or explicit product unsupported state
real Linux host E2E or explicit product unsupported state
non_claims: source contracts do not prove real cross-platform capture

requirements.requirement: Mouse/keyboard input injection is controllable, low-latency, and permission-correct
current_evidence: session view projects requested/effective input readiness and blocked reason
frontend input sender consumes daemon input_readiness and fails closed before sending pointer/key frames
display interactive sessions require an explicit input-control consent ticket before resolving display_global input scope
window/application sessions remain view_only until target-scoped keyboard/pointer dispatch is safe
pointer input frames carry target_geometry_revision when target-local geometry exists and the daemon rejects stale revisions before OS injection
session input_readiness reports target_input_not_ready when target tracking disables input
required_evidence_before_product_complet: target epoch checks on execution path
non_claims: view_only safety does not prove interactive input

requirements.requirement: Audio/video codec, frame rate, bitrate adaptation, and drop policy are product-ready
current_evidence: session/device capability view explicitly reports host_audio_not_implemented
ABI v8 raw stream metadata contract preserves canonical lifecycle fields without base64 payload projection
release packaging and install gates ship the v8 raw-stream export allowlist beside the base v7 ABI contract
non_claims: explicit host audio unsupported state does not implement audio capture
synthetic media carrier does not prove host audio/video product readiness

requirements.requirement: Multi-window/multi-application independent tracking works as an execution effect
current_evidence: application capture passes uncommitted same-app same-display windows as ScreenCaptureKit exceptingWindows
required_evidence_before_product_complet: multi-display MultiAppSurface implementation or explicit product unsupported report
real app/window churn E2E with independent tracked streams
non_claims: data structures alone do not prove independent tracking execution

requirements.requirement: Disconnect/reconnect, session resume, consent revoke, cancel, timeout are complete
current_evidence: explicit end_session and lease-timeout terminal_receipt projection
frontend retains closed end_session views with terminal_receipt while clearing session tokens
permission revocation terminates the daemon session with a terminal_receipt and frontend terminal sync
target loss and transport failure taxonomy

frontend preserves non-terminal RemoteApp sessions across device-offline presence drops, validates with remote_desktop.show_session on resume, and rebinds WebRTC without ending the daemon session on failed rebind
required_evidence_before_product_complet: long-outage and network transport reconnect handoff E2E
canonical Axon cancel/timeout receipt-chain evidence for RemoteApp abilities
non_claims: taxonomy and unit coverage do not prove recovery product behavior

requirements.requirement: NAT/relay/WebRTC/direct fallback network paths are verified
non_claims: route type source checks do not prove real NAT/relay reachability

requirements.requirement: Frontend UI can discover, authorize, start, display, control, and end session
current_evidence: component coverage for picker to consent to create to WebRTC attach to watch_events to end
protocol projection coverage for daemon input_readiness driven input gating
frontend protocol/store/UI coverage for daemon terminal_receipt projection after end_session
frontend permission-revoked recovery synchronizes daemon terminal_receipt through show_session
required_evidence_before_product_complet: picker to permission to consent to create_session
non_claims: component tests do not prove full real frontend product lifecycle

requirements.requirement: Cross-device E2E smoke/regression exists beyond local provider boundary
current_evidence: host-local decoded-frame scripts cover local capture/render decode
required_evidence_before_product_complet: RemoteApp-specific two-device or network namespace E2E
remote WebRTC/media from actual display/window/application capture
non_claims: cross-device routing and synthetic media do not prove real RemoteApp product behavior
